data.name: Hashaam
data.long_meaning: Hashaam is derived from the Arabic word ‘hassanah’ which means ‘a good deed’. In the Quran, Allah (swt) says, ‘Whoever brings a good deed will have ten like it’ (Quran 40:40). Therefore, Hashaam symbolizes the concept of giving and receiving blessings through good deeds.
